coverage_decision: All 8 primary-article pages and all 9 supplement pages were rendered and inspected. Every main and supplement figure/table was reconciled as structured content. Pure bibliography entries were excluded from atomization and exported separately as a 51-item task queue.
omissions: No bibliography entry was atomized as primary evidence. No external bibliographic correction was performed.
